scenes.hook: H T M L Lists Explained. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Lists group related items in a meaningful order. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Use an unordered list for bullets, and an ordered list for numbering. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Each list item belongs inside an L I element. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Pick numbering when the sequence of the items matters. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Create a numbered list of three steps in your morning routine. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
